Game Overview

Hippo vs Cow Monster puts players into a adventure experience centered on outsmart cow monsters and collect watermelons in this vibrant 2D platformer. Navigate treacherous terrains, dodge deadly obstacles, and master the art of double jumping. Each level increases in difficulty, challenging your skills as you race towards the red flag. Can you conquer the cow monsters and win the game?
